import html # Predefined template for blog posts. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced by the sanitized inputs. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped and formatted HTML snippet ready for safe rendering. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
